equivalent.why: Equivalent on the R7-B.2 bytes: the guard it removes (a clinical handler result outranks the block-choice question, QE-R7B1-01) is now subsumed by the precedence point. In evaluateProgram's decision step a handler returns CLINICAL_HUMAN_REQUIRED only through its own screen (exerciseSubstitution: substitutionClinical; returnAfterPause: interruptionScreen; no other handler or callee returns that status after admission, src/r6-adaptation.mjs and its imports), and clinicalRoute(kind,review) calls the same function on the same review (the factual re-plan context spreads ctx and keeps its review). So handled.status==='CLINICAL_HUMAN_REQUIRED' implies clinical!==null, and then decision0 is clinical before the mutated fragment is read. QE-R7B1-01's behaviour stays covered by the R7-B.1 tests (passing on these bytes) and by neighbor E (scripts/neighbors-r7b2.mjs). The fragment is left in place (smallest diff; no runtime change in U3).

inherited.note: Every other R7-B.1 mutant (M27-M40, M42-M57) and every R7-B mutant (M01-M25) keeps its result from R7B1-FREEZE-2 (r7/b1/MUTATION_R7B1_2.json, r7/b1/MUTATION_R7B_ON_R7B1_2.json): none of their fragments overlaps the R7-B.2 diff (baseline 033f300 -> this runtime), and each still occurs once in the new bytes.
